ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case and other Medicaid fraud cases to uncover the scope of the problem and identify potential patterns and connections.
questions: What is the scope of the Medicaid fraud problem?
Are there any connections between the Feeding Our Future case and other Medicaid fraud cases?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale problem with significant financial and human impact. I recommend starting with the Feeding Our Future case and expanding from there to identify other potential cases and connections.
